Video Production Studio v0.3.0

Record notes

Seventeen video methods and a portable Python renderer, timeline interchange and delivery QA.

Version 0.3.0 includes 17 complete skill procedures. Complete standalone runtime and methods; separate Video Templates MCP is optional.

Requirements: Python >=3.10; FFmpeg with drawtext; FFprobe; A usable font for typography.

License scope: MIT; bundled upstream MIT and Apache-2.0 notices apply. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add video-production-workflow@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files and includes a per-file hash inventory. Built from 334c118ac087eabf23c52a265632196818ddc5d3. SHA-256: c3f931a784865bb5a7eefe370c9580116caa50ddd74f1dddde5636eb1be28c6e.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
